Commentary.Commentary: A commanding position to be in. The Aussies will now bat and try to get something around 200 on the board, extending the total to something the Lions can't think of reaching. Sri Lanka, if they are to stand any chance, need wickets and they need them fast. There's a little something on offer for the bowlers, so let's see if they can take advantage of that.

The Sri Lankan first innings has been nothing short of eventful to say the least. They had two players retired hurt, one of whom came back, scored a fifty and departed instantly. And barring that opening stand of 82, nothing of substance came to be. On both occasions, the injuries to Karunaratne and Kusal Perera halted whatever momentum the visitors had gathered.

The Australian players are seen hurrying back, which means that the follow-on won't be enforced. Makes sense, given the bowlers might need a rest. Australia well and truly on top. They have a massive lead of 319 runs. Starc has been splendid in this innings, picking up his first 5-wicket haul of the summer and running riot through the Lankan batting order.

OUT! Five-wicket haul for Mitchell Starc. Full on off, the ball swings away just a hint after pitching. Fernando looks to defend but misses. The ball shatters the off pole. It is too good a delivery for a number 11 batsman. Venomous spell by Mitchell Starc and he gets his 10th Test 5-fer. Since Kusal Perera won't come out to bat, Sri Lanka are effectively bowled out for 215.
Back of a length delivery around off, Fernando keeps his defensive bat away from it.
Vishwa Fernando walks out next. He will probably be the last one to bat as it doesn't look like Kusal Perera will be able to bat today.

OUT! Another wicket down! Dilruwan the man to depart this time as Starc has his fourth. A loosener really, outside off at 140 clicks. Perera looks to cut this away but instead gets a feather behind. Tim Paine takes a simple catch.
Mitchell Starc to bowl from the other end.
Flighted leg break outside off, Kasun looks to defend but misses.
Flighted outside off, Rajitha gets an inside edge on that one and the ball goes towards mid on.
Play and a miss. Tossed up outside off, the ball spins away from Rajitha. He looks to drive but misses.
Flighted on the stumps, Kasun defends it.
Outside off to begin the session, Rajitha leaves it alone.
We are back for the post-Lunch session. Marnus Labuschagne to continue his pending over. Dilruwan Perera is joined by Kasun Rajitha.
... Third Day, Afternoon Session ...

After a solid start by the visitors to the session, it was another injury which changed the course of the session. A Jhye Richardson bouncer stuck Kusal Perera on the helmet. That rocked him and he was feeling signs of concussion and was not able to continue. Dimuth Karunaratne, who was injured yesterday, came to replace him. The opener got to his fifty but soon Dhananjaya de Silva, who was fighting hard, was the first man dismissed in the day. Dimuth soon followed him and was removed in the very same over. Starc was on fire in the first session and got 2 wickets. Lyon picked up one and just at the brink of Lunch, Marnus Labuschagne got his first of the game. The visitors are struggling at 215/7 and still trail the hosts by 319 runs. Join us again for the second session in a while.

OUT! The on-field call stays. Tossed up delivery on middle, Dickwella gets low to sweep but misses it and gets rapped on the front pad. Loud shout and the finger goes up. Dickwella signals the 'T' and takes it upstairs. Replays show that there is no bat or glove involved and the ball is clipping the top of the stumps. He isn't happy as he thought he got something on it, but Snicko barely showed any spike. Sri Lanka, however, don't lose the review. With that, it's LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Review taken. Dickwella has been caught leg before and given out. He's immediately taken the DRS. Inside edge maybe? Let's see.
Flatter on middle and off, Perera keeps it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter on off, Perera defends it off his front foot.
Tossed up on off, Dilruwan defends it.

Pitching on middle and leg, Perera looks to defend but misses. He gets struck on the thigh pads and there is a stifled appeal but the umpire turns it down. It looked like it was going wide of the stumps and high as well.
Flighted on off and middle, Perera defends it.
Change of ends for Nathan Lyon.
Tossed up outside off, Perera looks to cut but gets an outside edge past slip for a single.
Flatter on middle, Perera keeps it away.
On middle, Dilruwan defends it.
Tossed up on off, Dickwella brings out the reverse sweep and hits it to point for a single.
Flighted on middle, Dickwella plays a dangerous sweep shot towards fine leg for a couple.
Attempted leg spinner on middle, Perera flicks it to mid-wicket and gets off the strike.
Marnus Labuschagne to roll his arm over.

Ferocious bouncer to end the over! At 143.2 kph, Starc bangs it in short on off, it's sharp and accurate and there's nothing Dickwella can do about it. Almost edges it behind as he tries to awkwardly fend it away.
FOUR! Too far outside off and Dickwella puts it away. Back of a length delivery which the southpaw reaches out to and cuts it past gully. The chasing fielder has no chance to stop it.
Bangs it short and angles it down the leg side, the left-hander doesn't bother himself with it.
Back of a length on off stump, Niroshan stays behind the line and blocks it out.
Short ball on off, ducked and avoided by the batsman.

Dropped! Easiest of catches to any fielder. Starc doesn't fail to show his disappointment. Boy. Back of a length outside off, Dickwella pokes at it and edges it behind to Khawaja at first slip. It comes straight to Usman, but he spills it.
Flatter on off, Dickwella pushes it to cover and keeps the strike. 11 runs off the over.
Once again Dickwella brings out the sweep and gets a brace.
Flighted on off, Niroshan defends it.
Tossed up on leg, Dickwella sweeps it to fine leg and gets a brace.

Shorter on off, Dickwella cuts it through covers. Joe Burns at sweeper cover does well to cover the ground and stop the ball from racing away to the fence. The batsmen get a couple. Takes the total past 200 for Sri Lanka.
FOUR! Tossed up on off and middle, Dickwella gets on one knee and sweeps it in a controlled manner through mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Poor delivery by Starc. Length delivery down the leg side, Perera looks to flick it but gloves it wide of the keeper to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Bouncer. Dilruwan gets out of the way in time and the ball goes to Tim Paine.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Perera looks to defend it but it goes just wide of his outside edge.
Once again length delivery, Dilruwan keeps it out.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Perera keeps it out with a back foot defense.
Full on off, Dickwella hits it straight down the ground. It is not timed well to go to the fence but it is enough for the batsman to get three runs.
FOUR! Tossed up around off, Perera is done with the waiting game. He charges down the track and lofts it over mid-wicket. The ball bounces inside the ropes and goes away for a boundary.
On off, Dilruwan keeps it out with a solid defense.
Tossed up on middle, Perera defends it.
Shorter on off, Niroshan cuts it square to point and gets to the other end.
Flighted outside off, Dickwella leaves it alone.
Shorter on middle. The ball spins away after pitching. Dickwella hits it wide of cover but for some strange reason, they don't take the single.
Outside off, Perera leaves it alone.
On a length on the stumps, Dilruwan defends it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Painful! Back of a length delivery on middle. Perera looks to play it but the ball skids onto him. It hits his thumb and onto the helmet. Starc is throwing some fire balls here.
Ouch! Bouncer on leg, Perera looks to duck underneath it. He is a tad late on it and the ball brushes his shoulder and goes to the keeper.
Full on off, Dickwella pushes it wide of the cover fielder and rotates the strike.
Outside off, Perera cuts it to the fielder at short third man.
Dilruwan Perera is the new batsman in the middle.

OUT! Chamika Karunaratne is a goner. Lyon gets his second wicket. Tossed up on off, the ball spins after pitching. Chamika looks to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball lobs to Mitchell Starc at leg gully and he takes a simple catch moving to his left. Lyon gets his second wicket.
On off, Chamika comes down the track and defends it. It hits the lower half of the bat and rolls behind just wide of the stumps.
Spinning in on middle and leg, worked into the leg side. No run taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Dickwella reverse sweeps it past the diving point fielder for a single.
Wide down the leg side, No trouble at all for the batsman.
Chamika Karunaratne walks out to the middle.

OUT! Two wickets in the over for Starc. Slightly fuller outside off, Karunaratne sees this as an opportunity to score runs as this is not a short ball. He goes for the drive but gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes to the fielder at backward point. Kurtis Patterson there makes no mistake and holds on to it. The dangerous Karunaratne departs and Australia now on top with half the Sri Lankan side back in the hut.
Bouncer down the leg, Karunaratne looks to hook but misses.
Back of a length delivery to welcome Dickwella. He gets on top of it and flicks it to covers for a single.
Niroshan Dickwella is the new batsman in.

OUT! This is the most weird and unlucky mode of dismissal. Bouncer from Starc, de Silva looks to hook it but misses. The bat on the followthrough hits the stumps and takes the bails off. The Australian players initially appeal for a catch and it is turned down by the umpire. They soon realize he is hit wicket. Dhananjaya has no clue and he is made to realize it by the Australians. The umpires go upstairs to check and the replays confirm he has hit the stumps with his bat.
What's going on here? Dhananjaya de Silva is out hit wicket but the umpires aren't too sure of it. So have gone upstairs to check with the third umpire.
Full on off, Dhananjaya looks to drive but it goes back to the bowler from the inner half of the bat.
FOUR! That's a confident shot from Dimuth. Gives the charge to this flighted ball, gets close to the pitch and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Goes with the spin and turns it away past short leg for one.
Steps out once more, it's a bit flatter, the batter pads it away as the ball lobs and falls on the off side.
Some air provided on this, outside the line of off stump, Dhananjaya steps out and defends.
Floats it up on a driving length, around off, de Silva uses the depth of the crease to go back and defend.
Spinning in from outside off, shorter in length, it's flicked down in front of mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on the thigh. De Silva looks to flick but misses it. The ball brushes off his thigh pad and they steal a single. The umpire signals it as leg bye.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On the pads, Dhananjaya flicks it away towards mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Length delivery on the stumps, de Silva defends it.
Full on off, this time Karunaratne hits it straight to mid on. The ball is not timed well. The fielder stops it on the edge of the fence and the batsmen come back for the third.

FOUR! What a way to get to your half century. His 22nd in Test match cricket. Length delivery outside off by Starc to begin with. Karunaratne gets onto his front foot and lashes it through point for a boundary.
Mitchell Starc is introduced into the attack for the first time today.

Drinks break. An eventful first hour. Plenty has happened. The Australians have bombarded the Lankans with the short ball and that's affected Kusal Perera. He took one on the helmet and that's resulted in him getting concussed. He's retired hurt, but Karunaratne has returned. 43 runs have been score so far, but the visitors are under the pump.
Worked into the leg side again with soft hands.
Turning into the batsman, slightly shorter in length, Dhananjaya goes deep inside the crease and turns it in front of short leg.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Spinning in from outside off, on a shorter length, the right-hander backs away and forces the punch through covers for two runs.
Beaten! De Silva goes back to play for the turn when there is none, the ball lands outside off and goes on straight. He pokes inside the line and almost edges it.
Tossed up delivery on off, de Silva comes down the track and pushes it away.
Shorter in length, de Silva pulls it away to keep the strike.

Once again length ball on leg, Karunaratne looks to pull but gets it off his thigh pad. There are shouts of catch it from the fielders and the bowler as the ball goes past the fielder at short leg. They take a run and the umpire signals it as leg bye.
Length delivery on leg. The ball goes away with the angle. Dimuth looks to pull it but misses.
Good length delivery on off, Karunaratne pushes it towards long on and gets a couple.
Around the wicket to Karunaratne. It is back of a length on the body. He does well to defend it.
Full on middle, Dhananjaya looks to defend but gets an inside edge towards backward square leg for a run.
Karunaratne resumes his innings from where he left off yesterday by tapping the tossed up ball back to the bowler.
This is dragged down even shorter on middle, de Silva gets onto his back foot and pulls it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter on middle, the ball spins into the batsman after pitching. De Silva hits it to the fielder at point.

Perera is definitely feeling a bit of dizziness. He's going off the field, right call in the end. Hope he recovers quickly. One injured player is replaced by one who has recovered from an injury. Dimuth Karunaratne is back on the field. He replaces Kusal Perera.
Flatter on middle, Dhananjaya keeps it out with a classical front foot defense.
Tossed up on middle, de Silva taps it back to the bowler.
Flighted on middle, Dhananjaya flicks it to the fielder at mid on.

The medical team is back out again to check on Kusal Perera. Does he have a concussion? He says he's fine, in fact is eager to continue, but you never want to risk anything with head injuries. He's staying out there though, already worn the helmet and taken his place at the non-striker's end.
On the pads, flicked away to the fielder at short fine leg.

Good shot and good fielding. Back of a length delivery on middle, Perera pulls it towards deep backward square leg. Joe Burns runs to his left and puts in a dive and flicks the ball away to Marnus Labuschagne. Joe Burns does well to save the boundary. The replays confirm he did indeed stop it cleanly and save two runs for his side.
Good length delivery on middle from over the wicket. Kusal flicks it to the on side. Dhananjaya asks for a single, Perera says no straightaway.
Follows that with another bouncer. Kusal this time ducks underneath it and the ball goes to the keeper.

Second time Kusal Perera has copped a blow on the helmet. He might need a change of helmets here, as some bits broke off. The physio is out to check on him. He looks okay though. New helmet on and Kusal Perera is ready to continue.

On the helmet. Ouch! Back of a length delivery on off, the ball comes towards the batsman with the angle. Perera is early to duck and it strikes him on the grill of the helmet on the side. The extra covering behind the helmet also comes off. Richardson straightaway goes to ask him whether he is alright.
Shorter in length, Perera looks to pull it away but misses the ball.
Change of ends for Jhye Richardson.
Shorter in length, de Silva blocks it away.
On middle and leg, Dhananjaya keeps it away.
Outside off, Kusal drives it wide of the point fielder for a single.
Flighted on off, Kusal pushes it straight to the fielder at point.
FOUR! Tossed up on off and middle. Perera gets on one knee and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Nathan Lyon introduced in the attack.
Bouncer down the leg side, de Silva looks to hook it but misses.
Bouncer. De Silva watches the ball till the last moment and then sways away. Good cricket all around. A well-directed bouncer is followed by a good leave.
Length delivery on the stumps, de Silva defends it calmly.
Full on middle and off, Dhananjaya blocks it away off his front foot.
Length delivery on off, Dhananjaya blocks it.
Good length delivery on off, de Silva defends it.
Length delivery outside off, Perera looks to defend it but it just goes past the outside edge. Richardson cannot believe that he has not edged that one.

FOUR! Back of a length delivery outside off, Perera looks to cut it but gets an outside edge towards the vacant third man region for a boundary. Not the most convincing boundaries but they will take it.
On the pads, Dhananjaya flicks it away to fine leg for a run.
Full on middle, de Silva defends it.

In the air but safe. Full on off, Kusal Perera goes for the drive but is not in complete control of the shot. Joe Burns at short cover dives to his right but cannot get close to it. Travis Head gives it a chase and saves the ball from crossing the rope. The batsmen come back for the third run.
Shorter in length, de Silva pulls it away for a single.
Length delivery on the stumps, Perera defends it to see off the over.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Perera looks to push it but gets beaten.

Length delivery on middle and off, de Silva looks to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads and goes to the on side. There is a half-hearted appeal from the fielders. The umpire is not interested. The batsmen pick up a single.
Full on middle, Dhananjaya keeps it out.
Bouncer! It is quick around off, de Silva sways away.
Good length delivery on off, Dhananjaya defends it.
FOUR! Full on off, Perera gets on his front foot and drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.
Bouncer. Perera looks to pull but does not commit to it fully. The ball goes past him.
Shorter in length, de Silva pulls it away to backward square leg for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, Dhananjaya pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
On a length around off, de Silva defends it.

FOUR! Dropped. De Silva survives. Full on middle and leg, Dhananjaya flicks it uppishly. Marcus Harris at short mid-wicket jumps and gets his hands to it but cannot hold on. The ball has enough on it to reach the fence.
Second bumper in a row and it's the second time Kusal Perera ducks and lets it sail over his head.
Bumper from Cummins, Kusal picks it up early and ensures to get out of the way.
Full delivery hurled outside off, it's pushed towards the covers. Dot ball.
Fraction straight in line, fullish in length, de Silva uses the wrists as he flicks it through to deep square leg for one.
On the fuller side of the length, just outside off, Dhananjaya comes ahead and meets it with the full face.
On a length and around off, a solid defensive shot on offer from the batter.
Perera has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Bouncer. Perera ducks underneath it. Australia attacking Sri Lanka with the shorter one from time to time here.
Shorter in length, de Silva gets on top of the bounce and flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
Back of a length, de Silva solidly defends it.
Good length delivery on off, Dhananjaya defends it off his front foot.
Length delivery around off, de Silva blocks it.
Length delivery on off, blocked by coming half-forward.

Another short ball, quicker in pace this time, takes de Silva by surprise as he tries to pull. It goes off the helmet and falls on the leg side. Runs signalled by the umpire, so maybe some top edge involved as well.
FOUR! First boundary of the day. Good shot from Dhananjaya. Short ball into the body, he rises and rolls his wrists on this pull shot. Places it along the turf through square leg and finds the fence.
Rising off the deck, a good length delivery outside off, the right-hander stays behind the line and defends.
Back of a length delivery on off stump, met with a straight bat in defense.
Right on the money immediately. Length delivery on off stump, de Silva defends it solidly.
Pat Cummins to bowl from the other end.

Caught on the helmet! After what happened yesterday, nobody wants to risk anything. Lyon jogs up to Perera to ask if he's okay, he signals he is. Richardson hits the deck hard and bowls it short on leg, the left-hander looks to pull but it goes off the glove and catches the batsman on the helmet. The back flap falls off as the ball falls on the leg side.
Short of a good length on off, kept out off the back foot.
Fuller length delivery, just outside off, driven with hard hands towards mid off where the fielder makes a tumbling stop to his right.
Switches the angle to around the wicket and bangs it in short. Kusal Perera ducks and evades.
Full length delivery angling in on middle and leg, de Silva flicks it down to fine leg and picks up a single.
Good length delivery just around off, Dhananjaya brings his front foot forward and meets it with the full face.

We are going to begin now. Dhananjaya de Silva and Kusal Perera will continue from where they left off on Day 2. Jhye Richardson will start off with the ball. Two slips and a gully in place. Here we go...

Welcome to all the action from Day 3 in this second Test between Australia and Sri Lanka. Some good news first up - Dimuth Karunaratne has been cleared to play after the neck injury he suffered on Day 2. More good news for the hosts is that it's nice and sunny out there and it should be great for batting. Though, they did stumble a bit after losing three wickets. Starc's final spell just before Stumps really did them in. A lot of work to be done, unless the middle order can replicate something similar to the Burns-Head partnership, it's more or less over for the tourists. Before all this happened, Australia posted a mammoth 534/5 on the board before declaring, owing to centuries from Joe Burns, Travis Head and Kurtis Patterson, with two out of three scoring their maiden tons in Test cricket. Let's see how it all unfolds today.
... Third Day, Morning Session ...

The hosts will feel content walking back to the dressing room. They have a big total on the board and have Sri Lanka pegged on the back foot. A few runs were scored freely, but nothing that would make them lose sleep. Barring Richardson, everyone who bowled picked up a wicket each and did well for the most part. Day 3 should encourage them more as the ball is turning a fair bit already, and should do more to assist Nathan Lyon. Moving day will be a testing one for the tourists, to say the least. It will begin at 1030 local (2330 GMT, previous day). Join in for all the action. Cheers!

Advantage Australia! They had to toil hard for it though. The hosts struggled for a good while, as the Lankan openers added 82 runs before a rather unfortunate incident let the Aussies get on top. Dimuth Karunaratne caught a sharp one from Cummins and he had to be stretchered off after that. That halt in play distorted the Lankan momentum and three wickets fell after that till the end of day's play. Thirimanne, Mendis and Chandimal all made their way back without troubling the scoreboard much.

Over the wicket for the final ball of the over. Goes for the yorker but doesn't hit his mark. Ends up dishing out a full ball on off which Kusal Perera drives to mid off. Sri Lanka still trail by 411 runs and that's STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Shortish again, down the leg side once more, the left-hander manages to get out of the way.
Short of a good length down the leg side, the batsman covers the line and lets it go.
Quick single taken. Good running. Dhananjaya taps it down in front of cover-point and gets across to the other end.
Fullish in length as Starc keeps it outside off, de Silva plants his front foot forward and defends.
Angling in from outside off, a good length delivery, arms are shouldered.
Tossed up outside off, turning away, left alone.
Going away from the batsman after landing outside off, Kusal Perera has nothing to do with it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On a driving length, around off, blocked comfortably.
Short and wide outside off, cut behind point from the back foot. The fielder chases it down and keeps the batsmen down to two.
Peach! Served on middle and off, slightly shorter in length and it turns away. Kusal Perera goes back to defend and almost nicks it behind. That was so, so close.
Speared in full, close to off and angling in, Dhananjaya blocks with the full face. A wicket-maiden for Mitchell Starc, that'll make him feel much better.
Shortish delivery outside the line of off stump, de Silva gets behind the line and blocks it down.
An accurate yorker on off stump, de Silva manages to dig it out.
Dhananjaya de Silva strides out to the middle.

OUT! Starc with a ripper of a delivery. Takes the Sri Lankan skipper by surprise with a short ball and all he can do is awkwardly fend at it and get a glove behind. Paine collects and appeals, the finger goes up and everyone celebrates. The left-armer was bowling in good rhythm, this delivery was just too good for Chandimal. The visitors are slowly losing their way.
Starc is steaming in. Clocks a 147 clicks this time, bowls it on a back of a length, Chandimal cuts it straight to point.
Good length delivery outside off, at 149 clicks, Chandimal leaves it alone.
Pitched on a driving length, around off, defended square on the off side. End of the over.
FOUR! Finds the gap and finds it well. Perera waits for the ball to come before rocking back and crunching it through covers. A boundary results.
Goes with the spin and taps it away on the off side.
Decent effort from Pat Cummins. Chandimal backs away and forces the punch to cover-point. The fielder there moves to his right and keeps the batsmen down to one.
Skips down the track and pads it away to the left of the bowler.
Looped up outside off, the Lankan captain gets low to sweep. Is caught on the pads but no appeal as the impact is outside off.
Just about digs it out. Starc with a yorker just outside off, he gets an inside edge and the ball falls on the off side. Could have just as easily dragged it back onto the stumps.
Over the wicket to the left-hander, full on the stumps, pushed off the outer half to the right of cover.
Dinesh uses the angle into him by flicking it behind square leg. Moved inside the line and got a single as a result.
Fires it full and angles it in on off, driven straight back to the bowler.
A tad short, outside off, cut but right at backward point.
Short of a good length in the channel outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.

In the air again but short of Joe Burns at covers. Short ball which comes slightly slower to the batsman, Perera goes back and mistimes the cut to covers. Falls short of Burns who gets low to try and catch it.
FOUR! In the air but in the gap as well. Short and turning away around off, Perera shifts his weight on the back foot and cuts it through covers for a boundary.
provides some air, Perera defends it with the full face of his bat.
Slower through the air, on middle stump, Kusal Perera backs away a bit and punches it towards covers.
In line of the stumps again, it's punched to the left of the bowler towards mid on.
Flighted ball on the stumps, defended off the outer half on the off side.
Spears it full, outside off, drilled but can't get it past Cummins at short extra cover.
Edged and FOUR! Tim Paine doesn't mind though. Goes away from around off, Chandimal does well to play it with soft hands. It falls short and wide of third slip and runs away to the fence behind.
FOUR! The left-armer throws it too far outside off, Chandimal chases after it and slaps the cut through point. No stopping that one, hit too well and right in the gap.
Leans into the full delivery and drives it to mid off.
Starc bowls it a bit short, Chandimal sticks back and offers a firm punch to the cover fielder.
Short of a good length angling across, Dinesh rises on his toes and taps it down on the off side.
Mitchell Starc called back on.
Stays behind the line and keeps it out safely. Maiden from Lyon.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. Another dot.
A silly point in place and Perera was gone. Pitches on middle and it spins away, takes the leading edge as Kusal looks to flick. Through the vacant silly point position.
Quite full on off, blocked.
Beaten! Lyon finding his rhythm here. Beautifully tosses it up on off and it spins ever so slightly. Goes past the outside edge of Perera's hanging bat and thuds into the keeper's gloves.
Turning and leaving the batsman. Slower through the air around off, Perera makes a watchful leave.
Shortish delivery around off, Chandimal rises on his toes and defends it down.
Top edge but safe. Cummins comes from around the wicket and angles the short ball down, Perera takes the pull on but it goes off the edge. It goes down to fine leg and a single is taken.
Short of a length around off, pushed defensively on the off side.
On the shorter side of things once more, around off, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Back of a length on off stump, Kusal Perera stays back and keeps it out.
Kusal Perera is the new man in.

OUT! GONE! Absolute jaffa from Pat Cummins. What a delivery. What a delivery! Kusal Mendis was left with no chance to do anything about it. Came in at first after landing on off, straightens up after hitting the deck. Mendis looks to defend after being squared up a bit and the ball goes past the outside edge. The off stump is knocked over and that's another wicket down for Sri Lanka.
This full ball is swept through the gap in the leg side for a couple.

Not out! Well, well... it's missing leg stump. Doing too much. In all honesty, difficult to have judged that. Australia lose the review, through no real fault of their own though. Tossed up outside off, it turns in sharply. Chandimal is forward in defense but is caught on the front pad. Loud appeal goes up but the umpire shakes his head. Tim Paine speaks with his bowler and the 'T' is signalled. Replays show it's spinning down and missing leg stump.
Review taken by Australia. Could be close. It's for an lbw decision against Dinesh Chandimal. Impact is the criteria in question. Could go either way. Over to the TV umpire now...
Looped up on off, turned in front of short leg.
Lyon shortens the length on this occasion, it's spinning in from outside off, Chandimal gets behind the line and blocks.
Mendis gives the charge and whips it aerially in front of square leg. Once again it's in the air but through the gap. A single results.
FOUR! Flighted off break around off, Mendis shows positive intent by taking on the GOAT. He gets low and unfurls the slog sweep through mid-wicket for a boundary. Was a bit aerial, but in the gap.
In the gap this time. It's neatly clipped through the square leg area for a double.
Back of a length on middle, Chandimal moves inside the line, hops and wrists it to what appears to be a squarer leg gully. Straight to the fielder.
Ahead of a good length, around off, kept out from inside the crease.
Bumper angling in on middle and leg, Dinesh crouches and lets it sail over his head.
Back of a length on off, Mendis taps it down on the off side and takes off. The throw comes in at the bowler's end but it's well side. Single completed.
Angling in at first but then straightens off the seam, around off, Chandimal closes the face early and gets a safe leading towards point. Single taken.
Kusal Mendis to bat next.

OUT! Finally... gets the line right, gets the length right and bags the wicket as a result. Sri Lanka were jolted in the previous over with Karunaratne's injury, now they've lost Thirimanne. Lyon makes the opener play at this by landing it around off, on a driving length. It turns just enough as Thirimanne pokes at it. The ball goes off the edge and into Usman Khawaja's hands at first slip.
FOUR! A loose ball. Shorter in length with some width on offer, Thirimanne cuts this behind point to earn another boundary.
A bit short, close to off, blocked from inside the crease.

FOUR! He's hit it well. The offie shouldn't be disappointed though, he has two men out there in the deep. Should definitely persist with this line and length. Tossed up around off, Thirimanne slog sweeps it over mid-wicket and finds the fence.
Lyon is slightly on the shorter side as he lands this on off, it spins away and the opener rocks back to defend.
Flighted off break around off, turns slightly, Thirimanne covers the line and leaves it alone.

Quite a lot of movement for Cummins. It shapes in a long way and even angles down, Chandimal doesn't offer a stroke and it brushes off his thigh pad down the leg side. No run taken, as the batsman didn't offer a shot.
Length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Chandimal moves a step across, gets behind the line and meets it with a straight bat.

The physio runs out without wasting any time. Doesn't look good as of now. Karunaratne isn't moving at all as he's being looked at. The umpires have called for a stretcher and the Australian medical staff is out there. Quite a few of them actually. The Australian players have circled around to check in on him as well. Nothing is being rushed here, everyone's taking their time. He's being stretchered off, won't take any further part at least today. Hope it's nothing too serious and he can rejoin play tomorrow. Dinesh Chandimal will be walking in to take his place.

That really shook him up! Nasty one from Pat Cummins. Karunaratne is down on the ground immediately. Sharp bouncer from Cummins, takes Dimuth by surprise. He looks to duck but is caught around the side of the neck.
On the fuller side of things, kept out off the front foot comfortably.
Fires it full and pitches it outside off, Karunaratne comes forward, goes across and flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Full length delivery on off stump, defended off the inner half to the leg side.
Tossed up delivery outside off, turning away, another leave to end the over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Spinning away, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Takes the aerial route and clears the infield with ease. Thirimanne slog sweeps it over mid-wicket and takes two.
Floats it up there, quite slow through the air, Thirimanne plays it under his nose.
Tossed up off break on middle and off, blocked from the inner half on the leg side.
Bit fullish in length, around off, Dimuth blocks with the full face of the bat.
Back of a length outside off, no shot offered by the batsman.
Good length ball outside off, going on straight, Thirimanne dabs it to point.
Cummins once more pitches it a fraction straight in line, Dimuth turns it to square leg and changes ends.
Spills it on the pads, the batsman flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Jags back in, Cummins serves it on a length, Thirimanne attempts to flick but is struck on the thigh pad.

Drinks are on the field. A good hour for Sri Lanka. They're carrying on the good work from the Tea break and the surface isn't bothering them too much. Australia will, like the Lankans had to before, or tried to at least, come up with something innovative to get a wicket or two here. Also, Pat Cummins is back into the attack.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A defensive push from Dimuth. The balls rolls to the cover region. No run taken.
Drags his length a touch short, close to off, Karunaratne forces the punch off the back foot.
Loopy and fuller, wider outside off, driven straight to the man at cover.
A bit slower through the air, on a driving length around off, Dimuth pushes it square on the off side by coming forward.
Tossed up delivery, drifting on the pads, Lahiru tucks it square on the leg side and crosses over. It's a leg bye actually as it's gone off the pads.
FOUR! Top edge and away! Some luck with the Lankans now. Banged in short, Karunaratne looks to nail the pull but it goes off the top edge over the keeper's head. It's a boundary after that.
Opens the bat face and dabs it to the vacant cover-point area. Single taken.
Targets the top of off stump with a length ball, the left-hander guards it out safely.

A slight halt in play as Thirimanne is receiving medical attention. That last delivery must have really hurt, so the magic spray is out and doing its thing. The players use this opportunity to get some fluids in.
Sharp from Jhye Richardson. Short and on middle, Thirimanne is taken by surprise as it comes too fast. He awkwardly tries to fend it away but takes a blow on the glove. He's in pain here.
Uses the angle coming into him and flicks it away into the leg side for a run.
Just ahead of a length, around off, blocked from inside the crease.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Short and wide, cut to backward point where Travis Head misfields and conceded a single.
Nice shape on this. It drifts in and then turns away, Dimuth blocks with the full face.
Backs away to this shorter ball and punches it wide of cover. Thirimanne wants the run and sets off, but is sent back. No danger this time either. Need to be a bit careful though.
Tosses this one up, keeps it around off, Karunaratne once again comes forward and defends.
Loopy and full around off, spinning away, Karunaratne presses forward and defends.
Full delivery on off stump, driven straight back to the bowler.
Worked off the inner half in front of mid-wicket.

Bit of a mix-up. No harm done though. Thirimanne flicks it towards square leg. Karunaratne has taken off and is halfway down the track. He has to retreat as the throw comes in at his end. It's a bit wide so he makes it back in.
Shaping back into the batsman, it's worked to the man positioned in front of square leg.
Angling in on leg, Karunaratne attempts to flick but it goes off his thigh pad down to fine leg. A leg bye is collected.
Sharp from Richardson. Angles in a length delivery from around the wicket, catches Dimuth on the thigh pad as he tries to play across the line. No appeal as it was too high.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On the pads, it is flicked to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up on middle, the batsman keeps it out with a forward stride.
On middle, the batter goes back and pushes it to mid on.
On the shorter side again, Thirimanne goes back and then guides it to point.
Slightly short and outside off, the batter goes back and punches it to covers.
Bumper! The batsman evades it.
Fullish and on off, Karunaratne strokes it to mid off.
In the corridor of uncertainty, the batsman though was certain about not playing it.
Attacks the off pole, the batsman defends it onto the ground.
A little too straight, it is flicked uppishly but just away from the fielder at short mid-wicket. Two taken.
On off, the batter gets right behind the line and defends it. This is very tight stuff by the Aussies. They have hardly given anything away after the break.
Loopy ball around off, blocked.
On middle, the batsman lunges and defends it back to the bowler.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Works it with the angle through mid-wicket for a single.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
On the shorter side, the batter pushes it to mid on for a single.
Length again around middle, Thirimanne is solid in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Glorious shot! There was nothing wrong with the delivery, maybe he provided just a little width outside off. Thirimanne leans into it and strokes it on the up through covers.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Good line and length! In the 5th stump channel. Thirimanne first thinks of playing at it but then lets it be.
On the off stump, Karunaratne pushes it to wide mid on for a run.
Jhye Richardson is on now.
Flighted ball on the leg stump, Thirimanne lunges and looks to defend. The ball goes off the inner half and on the bounce to the fielder at short leg.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball.
Shorter in length, it is pushed to covers for a run.
On the stumps, kept out.
This is flicked with the angle and through square leg for a run.
Flatter and outside off, Thirimanne guides it through point for a couple.
Around off, Lahiru plays it with a closed face. It goes through square leg and the batsmen scamper through.
Short and on the body, Thirimanne ducks under it.
Good delivery! Lands it on middle and gets it to jag back in. Thirimanne looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Short again and the line is closer to the off pole, Thirimanne guides it to point.
Another one outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
Changes the angle and comes from over the wicket. Bowls it outside off, it is left alone.
The straighter one and on middle, Thirimanne with the turn works it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
A little fuller this time, Thirimanne easily keeps it out.
BEATEN! Nicely tossed up on off, Thirimanne plays inside the line. The ball spins away and goes past the outside edge.
Floats it up outside off, Thirimanne defends it towards covers.
Fired on the pads, it is worked around the corner for a run.
Flighted ball on off, blocked.
Short and around off, Lahiru gets on top of the bounce and guides it to point.
Another bumper, the batter spots it early this time and ducks under it.
Just behind a driving length, Karunaratne leans into it and pushes it towards wide mid off for a quick run.

Slightly short and outside off, Karunaratne stands tall and then guides it through point for a couple. 50 up between the two openers. Ideal start for the Lankans. However, they need to continue. Still trail by another 484 runs.
A bumper on middle, Karunaratne ducks under it.
First run of this session! It has come on the 19th ball of this session. Full and on the pads, Thirimanne works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Another maiden! 3 in a row! On the stumps, Karunaratne lunges and keeps it out.
He is sure about playing this off the back foot as the ball is short. Finds point though with the cut shot.
Well bowled! This is flatter and lands it on a length which the batsman is not sure whether to come forward or stay back. Karunartne defends it with his feet rooted to the crease.
On the stumps, Karunaratne prods forward and blocks it out.
Goes back, waits the ball to do its bit and then punches it to covers.
Nicely flighted and lands it around middle, Karunaratne with the turn strokes it to covers.
Slightly fuller in length around off, Thirimanne this time keeps it out off the front foot. Two maidens to begin with.
Cramps the batsman for room by bowling it on his body, Thirimanne defends it onto the ground.
Slightly outside off, the opener opens the face of the bat and then guides it to gully.
Back of a length again, Thirimanne pushes it to covers.
This is angled into the batsman, Thirimanne nudges it to square leg.
Back of a length around off, it is defended.
Pat Cummins to bowl from the other end.
End of a good first over after the break by Lyon. On the stumps again, DK blocks it out.
Another tossed up ball on off, Karunaratne pushes it towards covers.
Gives it a lot of air now, Karunaratne lunges and defends it onto the ground.
Tosses it up this time around middle, Karunaratne is unsure whether to go forward or play it from the back foot. He somehow keeps it out by staying in his crease.
Extra bounce there! It is flatter and a touch shorter, takes off after pitching. Hits the sticker of Karunaratne's bat as he tries to defend.
Starts off with a flatter delivery and on middle, Karunaratne defends it.

We are back for the final session! The overrate has been good today so we only have 30 overs left. The Lankan openers make their way to the middle. Dimuth Karunaratne is the man who will be on strike. He will face Nathan Lyon who will continue his spell. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

Sri Lanka have done well to see the remainder of the session out without incurring any damage. Australia posted a big total first up on the backs of big knocks from Burns and Head, followed by Patterson, and then declared. The Lankans came out to bat and did fairly well on a surface which isn't assisting the bowlers much. Dimuth Karunaratne and Thirimanne have held their own and stood their ground. Though, the final session should be a bit interesting as the ball has started to take some turn, which was showed in Lyon's first over itself. We'll see how it all plays out.
Cummins makes it go away, angles it across. Thirimanne has nothing to do with it. TEA ON DAY 2!
Outside off on a good length, left alone.
Marginally ahead of a length, on off stump, Thirimanne meets it with the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Takes the aerial route and gets the desired result. Shortish outside off, Thirimanne cuts it over point. Once it's over the infield, there's no chance for anyone to stop it.
Fast hands from the southpaw. He punches this through covers by rising on his toes. Three runs in total taken. Good timing on that.
Good carry for Pat Cummins. He serves a length delivery outside off and it zips off the deck. Karunaratne watchfully lets it go past him.
Sticks on the back foot and offers a defensive punch to the covers.
Short and wide outside off, cut off the outer half towards gully. Was a bit aerial, but fell short of the fielder.
Spinning away with some extra bounce, Dimuth punches it through extra cover and gets to the other end.
Plants his front foot forward and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up delivery around off, Thirimanne comes forward and defends.
Sharp spin for Lyon straightaway. Lands it on off from around the wicket and it spins away. Thirimanne hangs his bat inside the line and gets beaten.
Time for some spin. Nathan Lyon to roll his arm over.
Closes the face and works it off the inner half to square leg. Single taken.
Zipping off the surface, a length ball outside off, an easy leave for the batsman.
Banged in short, at a good pace, Lahiru Thirimanne arches back and lets it be.
Slightly fuller in length, around off, once again it's defended off the inner half to the left of the bowler.
Fuller and outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Full delivery, coming in from just outside off, Thirimanne plants his front foot across and defends it off the inner half on the leg side.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
On the fuller side, it is stroked through mid on and the batsmen take three.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A bumper on middle, the batsman ducks under it.
Length again around off, the batter is solid in defense.
Good length on off, blocked.
FOUR! Shot. One every batsman enjoys. Straight down the ground. Karunaratne gets this in his slot and he drives it past the bowler to find the fence.
Angling back in, Dimuth moves inside the line and flicks it to the man at square leg.
On a length, aiming the top of off stump, Dimuth defends it right under his nose.
Angles in a length ball on off, Karunaratne stays behind the line and closes the face to work it on the leg side.
Around the wicket, goes full again, driven back to the bowler.
Full delivery in line of the stumps, it's defensively pushed towards mid on.
Pat Cummins is the first bowling change for Australia.
Way outside off, the batter leaves it alone.
Sharp bumper, angling across, the batsman lets it be.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Poor ball and it's rightly put away. Full and wide outside off, a half-volley, Thirimanne drives it through point and finds the fence.
A touch straight in line, worked in front of square leg for one run.
First runs off Richardson's bowling. Dimuth punches it off the back foot through covers and takes two.
Plays and a miss! Length delivery on the fourth stump line, Thirimanne looks to drive on the up but fails to connect.
Run out chance missed. Dimuth taps it wide of cover and takes off. Head moves to his right, picks the ball up and fires a throw at the striker's end. Just misses. Had he it, Thirimanne was a goner.
Cutting back in from a good length, with some extra bounce, catches Karunaratne on the thigh pad as he tries to put bat on ball.
Back of a length around off, kept out without any trouble.
Bumper from Starc, Dimuth sways away from the line and lets it through.
FOUR! Shot. Too straight on the pads, Dimuth flicks it behind square leg and the placement is so good that it finds the fence.
Played to the point region by the batsman. Dot ball to end the over.
Behind a good length, around off, Thirimanne is on the back foot to keep it out.
Once again it's full outside off, Thirimanne leaves it alone.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Outside off on a good length, no shot offered yet again.
Angles it across from a good length, outside off, left alone.
Full in line of the stumps, driven towards mid on to end the over.
Bumper around off, ducked and evaded by the batsman.
Fuller length delivery on off stump, a straight bat in brought down in defense.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. Dot ball.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, left alone.
Full, it starts from outside off and it tails back in. The batter mistimes it back towards the bowler.
So another leave means all the six balls have been left in this over. A maiden but not a threatening one.
Make that 5! Another ball which is not on the stumps, the batsman lets it go to the keeper.
4th leave in a row as this is one is way too wide.
Closer to the off pole but not close enough to make the batsman play.
Another one outside off, the batsman is in no mood to play at those. So Starc is bowling a little too straight and Jhye is bowling a little too wide outside off.
Length delivery outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Cuts and cuts hard! Short and outside off, Karunaratne throws his bat at it, gets it off the middle and over point for a boundary. 7 from Starc's second, he is leaking runs here.
Back of a length around off, the batter stands tall and defends it onto the ground.

This is where he should be bowling! Good length and around off, no movement this time though. Thirimanne taps it towards cover and sets off for a run. The fielder hits bull's eye at the striker's end but the batsman is well in.
Better by Starc! Starts from around off this time, Karunaratne still manages to flick it through mid-wicket for a single.
A quick bumper, it kept climbing on the batsman who ducks under it. Paine does well to leap and get a glove to it. It rolls towards third man for a bye.
A little too straight and the batter finds square leg with his flick. Starc needs to start from outside off and then get it to tail back in.
Just ahead of a length, around off, patted away defensively from the front foot.
Back of a length on off stump, Karunaratne defends it down in front of covers.
Quite far outside off as it lands on a length, no way the batter will bother himself with that.
Length delivery angling across, another leave from the opener.
Outside off once more, some good carry for Richardson. Dimuth shoulders his arms to it.
Full and wide outside off, Karunaratne leaves it alone.

Another top effort in the field! This time it is Cummins. On the pads again by Starc. Karunaratne this time helps himself by working it through mid-wicket. Cummins from mid on gives it a chase and just before it crosses the ropes, he dives and pulls it back inside. Saves a run for his side. 11 from the first over. A really poor one from Starc.
Another one on the pads, Thirimanne clips it towards square leg and gets to the other end.

Excellent effort in the field there by Richardson. A little too straight by Starc. Thirimanne flicks it through square leg and it has boundary written all over it but Jhye runs to his right, dives and saves a run for his side.
Swing there! Starts off from middle and it tails back in. Thirimanne looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. A muted appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Another one on the pads, it is clipped towards fine leg for a run. A wayward start by Starc.
FOUR! Karunaratne is off the mark in style! Positive start for the Lankans. A full delivery and no the pads, Karunaratne just gets bat to it and the ball races away to the square leg fence.
